text:
leo: Quick note 1 opened a small PR to swap the large heatmap with a compact CSV delta table and update trace-hook params. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4302

maya: Thanks. Which snippets?

leo: Two examples in console/examples/heatmap.md: node + python. Need `trace_key` instead of `traceid`, and change `prefetch=True` -> `prefetch=\"windowed\"`. Also avoid absolute latency numbers.

own: I can run markdown-lint and fix the code-fence languages. There's a broken anchor in the cost table I can patch.

jen: I'll update the python snippet and run it through the sandbox. Prefer showing p95 + avg as the latency SLOs.

maya: Add a one-line \"how to read\" that says: \"prefetch lowers tail latency but can increase per-token cost; numbers shown are relative deltas from baseline.\" Keep wording short.

jen: Draft python snippet: ```python
from redwood import ConsoleClient
client = ConsoleClient()
resp = client.trace_hook(model=\"xgen-7b\", trace_key=\"example_session\", prefetch=\"windowed\")
print(f\"p95: {resp.metrics['p95_latency_ms']} ms | avg: {resp.metrics['avg_latency_ms']} ms | cost delta: {resp.metrics['cost_delta_percent']}%\")
```

own: Looks good. Replace example_session with a placeholder like `<TRACE_KEY>` in the doc. I'll push the anchor/code-fence fixes to your branch.

maya: Also add a short note under the CSV: \"environment: benchmark on G5-like hardware; results will vary.\"

docs-bot: CI started for PR 4302 and linter PR 4303. Snippet sandbox queued.

leo: Action list: owen - land lint + anchor fix, jen - push sandboxed snippet, maya - update prose & replace absolutes with relative deltas. Will wait for CI green, then merge.

own: will open fix PR in a bit.

jen: Sandbox returned green locally; pushing snippet now.

maya: thanks all, keeping thread pinned to the PR until merge. If CI flags anything, drop a short note here.
